description: Java class implementing an adapter for mapping SubscriptionEvent objects to and from Adaptable representations within the Eclipse Ditto protocol framework.

classes.name: SubscriptionEventAdapter
classes.description: Final class that adapts SubscriptionEvent objects to and from Adaptable representations, handling different subscription event types and mapping them to appropriate topic paths and payloads.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new SubscriptionEventAdapter with specified header translator and error registry.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type string for the adaptable, combining a prefix with the search action.

methods.name: mapSignalToAdaptable
methods.description: Maps a SubscriptionEvent to an Adaptable, setting the correct topic path and payload based on event type.

methods.name: getCriteria
methods.description: Returns the set of criteria (SEARCH) that this adapter is interested in.

methods.name: getActions
methods.description: Returns an empty set, indicating no specific actions are handled.

methods.name: isForResponses
methods.description: Indicates this adapter is not for response messages.

methods.name: getSearchActions
methods.description: Returns the set of search actions (COMPLETE, NEXT, FAILED, GENERATED) this adapter handles.
